title: Medicaid at Risk for Hundreds of Thousands of Lawfully Present Immigrants
summary: Hundreds of thousands of lawfully present immigrants could lose government health coverage. This change stems from healthcare cuts in a GOP budget law. KFF Health News’ Andrew Jones tells WAMU’s “Health Hub” which Medicaid enrollees are affected and shares resources for newly uninsured people in the Washington, D.C., area.

title: GOP Congressman in California Swing-District Race Defends Vote for Medicaid Cuts
summary: In a race that could help decide control of Congress, Republican U.S. Rep. David Valadao is trying to hold on to his swing-district seat. The congressman didn’t mention healthcare at a recent campaign rally in Bakersfield, but voters can't stop talking about it.

title: Shopping for an ACA Plan This Year? Here’s What You Need To Know
summary: As open enrollment for Affordable Care Act health insurance kicks off, consumers face rising premiums, additional identity checks, and fewer brokers.

title: Job-Based Health Plan Costs Rise, With Little Relief in Sight
summary: Employers saw their healthcare premiums rise 5% this year — and some passed on that burden to workers — as the cost of family coverage in job-based insurance exceeds $28,000 for family plans.

title: Listen to the Latest ‘KFF Health News Minute’
summary: The "KFF Health News Minute" brings original healthcare and health policy reporting from our newsroom to the airwaves each week.

title: Trump Dangles Rural Health Dollars To Push States To Change Hospital Laws
summary: The Trump administration has tied billions in rural health funding for states partly to the policy commitments they make, including ending their certificate of need, or CON, laws governing the construction of new hospitals.

title: ‘Go to Canada’: Trump Touted Americans’ Access to Cheaper Drugs. A New Rule Threatens It.
summary: The Trump administration pushed back a rule — until after the midterm elections — that would complicate Americans’ access to less expensive medication imports from Canada and other countries.

title: States Are Forcing Hospitals To Offer More People Financial Aid. In Oregon, It’s Working.
summary: Oregon passed a law to require hospitals to proactively screen patients to see if they qualify for financial aid. Patients got immediate relief. Hospitals pushed to roll back the law following federal cuts to Medicaid and Affordable Care Act subsidies.

title: New Arrivals in the ER? Georgia Gears Up To Solve Rural Maternal Health Crisis
summary: Most of Georgia’s counties are without a labor and delivery unit. To fill the gap, the state is looking to equip emergency rooms to handle obstetric emergencies. Advocates and doctors worry, however, that the ER is being used as a stopgap.

title: Democrats Demand Tougher Standards for Companies Running Medicaid Systems
summary: A year after launching an inquiry into companies, including Deloitte, that receive billions in taxpayer dollars to build complex computer systems determining Medicaid eligibility, senators are urging the federal government to impose stricter rules.
